newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HORSE RACING-TWO U.S. HORSES OUT AFTER FAILED TESTS.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-TWO U.S. HORSES OUT AFTER FAILED TESTS.

text.p: Two racehorses from the United States have been withdrawn from Hong Kong's showpiece International Cup race to be run later on Sunday after failing routine drug tests, local newspapers reported.
Da Hoss, a trump favourite and Breeders' Cup Mile winner, failed the routine pre-race drug test on Saturday and had to be pulled out of the HK$6.5 million (US$840,900) International Cup.
Mateo, also an American horse entered into the same race, failed a similar test, newspapers said.
Officials from the Hong Kong Jockey Club were not immediately available for comment.

In another blow to Sunday's famous event, top English sprinter Iktamal was pulled out of the HK$6 million (US$776,200) International Bowl with suspensory trouble, the South China Morning Post reported.
